# Amy Fitzpatrick

**Headline:** Founder CISO, decipHER women | Pharma Executive Medical Affairs Consultant
**Current role:** Founder Chief Innovation & Science Officer
**Location:** Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands
**Experience:** 22 years
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/amyfitzp · 2,035 followers
**Description:** We hope to build the first truly learning healthcare system. Our first mission is perhaps our society's most important healthcare concern - maternal mental health & other moribity / mortality affecting new & expectant moms. Mental health is biological and we think many bad outcomes can be predicted & averted. We are fundraising. If you see the (still) unmet need in women's health and are familiar with the (1) limitations and vagaries of using current EMRs for AI and (2) 20 year bench to bedside gap, but see that the solved combination of these could be powerful, we'd love to hear from you. http://www.decipherwomen.com/ Show less
